# Space and Tech Engineering LLP

> Made in India drone components. Flight controllers, AM32 ESCs and GPS modules for UAV and FPV builders. Designed in Mumbai and Nashik.

## Products
- [Aazmuth flight controller](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/product.html?p=aazmuth-flight-controller): Modular, triple-redundant flight controller with isolated sensors.
- [Exelr8 FPV flight controller F7](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/product.html?p=exelr8-fpv-flight-controller-f7): F7 flight controller for FPV builds.
- [Skydrive AM32 60A 3-6S](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/product.html?p=skydrive-am32-60a): 60A AM32 speed controller for 3-6S batteries.
- [Skydrive AM32 40A 3-6S](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/product.html?p=skydrive-am32-40a): 40A AM32 speed controller for 3-6S batteries.
- [Skydrive 55A AM32 4-in-1](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/product.html?p=skydrive-55a-am32-4-in-1): 4-in-1 AM32 ESC for FPV drones.
- [NAVSATE GPS for UAVs](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/product.html?p=navsate-gps-for-uavs): GPS module tuned for UAVs.
- [NAVSATE mini for FPV drones](https://www.spaceandtechengineerings.com/product.html?p=navsate-mini-gps): Compact GPS for FPV drones.
